790798.title: Jessica Frost
790798.overview: Pursued by a ruthless, time-jumping psychopath and his squad of assassins, a young woman plagued by family secrets must journey through the desert and beyond the boundaries of reality to find out who she really is and claim her destiny.

843342.title: Hamlet
843342.overview: When Hamlet returns for his father’s funeral, he is stunned to discover his uncle Claudius is marrying his newly widowed mother. Visited by his father’s ghost, Hamlet learns his brutal murder was at the hands of Claudius - and spirals into a quest for vengeance that exposes the rot at the heart of the family’s empire and threatens his own sanity.

874510.title: Colors of White Rock
874510.overview: Ever since its shift toward liberalism after the Cold War, Mongolia has opened up its mines in the Gobi desert for exploitation — resulting in an onslaught of truck convoys transporting Mongolian coal to China. Within this arduous, predominantly-male line of work, Maikhuu — a former taxi driver and hairdresser — stands alone as one of the only female truck drivers working the mining boom. A single mother, Maikhuu resorts to looking after her young children’s financial future and well-being by working extensive seasons along the unforgiving Gobi desert, all while her sister cares for her young children back home. As an outspoken and resilient driver, Maikhuu contends not just with severe droughts impacting the desert landscape, but also deadly accidents among the truck drivers as well as incessant competition from her dominating male peers. Throughout it all, Maikhuu exerts a tenacity in her arduous work and outlook on life.

949838.title: 72 HOURS
949838.overview: To save his career, a 40-year-old ad exec joins a crew of twentysomethings for a wild Miami bachelor party after they mistakenly add him to a group chat.

1061838.title: Pirate Mo and the Legend of the Red Ruby
1061838.overview: Aboard a ship, back when terrible pirates roamed the seven seas, a child, Mo, grows up with a crew of ragtag seadogs and the ship’s pet… goat. Having grown up into a brave girl, Mo must wrestle with her father’s career of piracy and overcome trials as she seeks to understand the enigma of her origin. Captured by the evil pirate Peg-Leg Olle, Mo bumps into cabin boy Hannes. Together with him, Claas and his motley crew, brave Mo will have to defeat Olle and find the Blood Red Blood Ruby of Doom, to restore peace and harmony to the land. Pirate Mo is a swashbuckling adventure full of heart, guts, and hope for a better world, led by a young girl whose goodness is matched only by her derring-do.

1084814.title: Flesh & Fuel
1084814.overview: A lonely French trucker's routine life on the road takes an unexpected turn when he encounters a Polish driver. As feelings develop, he struggles to balance his demanding job with a chance at love, determined to make their connection work.

1169166.title: The Children of Kozara
1169166.overview: Based on the novel of Arsen Diklić which describes the horror’s of concentration camp Jasenovac.

1185806.title: PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie
1185806.overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

1193550.title: California Schemin'
1193550.overview: In the late 1990s, Gavin Bain and Billy Boyd had their musical ambitions consistently ridiculed for having the 'wrong' accents, so they went for broke and reinvented themselves as Californian rappers. The duo re-recorded their own tracks with fake accents and turned up in London claiming to be an established duo on the Cali scene as well as childhood friends with Eminem. They quickly bagged themselves a record deal, a hefty sum in advances, and an appearance on MTV... until it all came crashing down.

1193614.title: Il faut brûler maman
1193614.overview: A comedy of manners set in a funeral home.

1208270.title: Tango at Dawn
1208270.overview: Ji-won, who had cut ties with everyone, takes a job at a factory that provides lodging and meals. She finds her roommate Ju-hee, a girl who dances the Tango all the time, both burdensome and intriguing. Ji-won gets involved in Hyun-woo's accident and feels uneasy as she watches Ju-hee try to take all the responsibility herself.

1211598.title: Kill Me
1211598.overview: Jimmy wakes up in a bathtub after having tried to kill himself. Or, at least, that’s what it looks like to his friends and family. Jimmy is pretty sure he didn’t do it… maybe. Together with Margot, the 911 operator who took his call, Jimmy sets out on a mission to solve a vitally important whodunit: did someone try to kill him, or are they chasing the spectre of depression?

1218062.title: Twisted
1218062.overview: As the heir to her parents’ legendary pizzeria, Angelina, a feisty Italian teenager, fears breaking tradition might break their hearts. As her desire to break free grows, so do her lies. But when her web of deceit spins out of control, she opens a portal to a wondrous and treacherous mythical underworld putting her family in grave danger. To right her wrong, she is forced to team up with a neurotic but sensitive, truth-telling monster. The unlikely duo sets off on a mind-blowing journey to save the very traditions Angelina wanted to leave behind. A modern coming-of-age adventure, Twisted explores the universal themes of soul-searching. It challenges our relationship with truth, lies and looks at how life-changing decisions can sometimes affect the people we love.

1220686.title: The Gymnast
1220686.overview: An aspiring Olympic gymnast and her single father who has dedicated himself to his daughter’s success. When the young athlete suffers a potentially career-ending injury, their relationship suffers as they fight to discover who they are without gymnastics.

1270734.title: Recruited
1270734.overview: Andrey Romanov finds himself at the epicenter of a clash between Russian and Western intelligence services. Together with his team of top Russian special agents, he is recruited by GRU officer Maksim Kolosov for a special mission into enemy territory. The group's goal is to find out what is happening in a secret laboratory near the border of the country, where work is underway on a new biological weapon. Andrey also has a personal goal - revenge. The enemy's team is led by his father's killer. Andrey's group is completely secret; almost no one knows about its true purpose. Everything does not go according to plan when it becomes clear that there is a "mole" among them.

1284046.title: Onslaught
1284046.overview: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

1286030.title: Apophis 2029
1286030.overview: On April 13, 2029, the asteroid Apophis will pass close enough to Earth, it will be below our satellites. It will dip below and pop back out.

1290062.title: Land of Shadows
1290062.overview: Following a tragic event that shattered her life, renowned author Alice Chevalier struggles to find meaning in her existence. Searching for answers and a sign from destiny, she meets Thomas, a mysterious man who offers her an experience that defies the boundaries of reality. Driven by the hope of rebuilding herself, Alice embarks on a mystical journey, like an astronaut venturing into the far reaches of the unknown.

1298510.title: WWE SummerSlam 2026: Sunday - Countdown
1298510.overview: Get the latest breaking news, rivalry analysis from a panel of experts, and much more before The Biggest Party of the Summer concludes on Sunday night!

1359694.title: A Family
1359694.overview: Caught in the crossfire of their parents’ divorce, Nina and Eli are torn between loyalty, anger and a longing to be seen. Through their mirrored perspectives the same story unfolds, revealing how love can fracture and still find its way.

1373198.title: Twisted
1373198.overview: Two millennials make quick money by leasing incredible New York City apartments they don’t own to people who don’t know they are being scammed. The con works brilliantly until they run into an apartment owner with a dark secret who flips the game on them.

1397390.title: Enquanto o Céu Não Me Espera
1397390.overview: A simple farmer, attached to the memories of his father, struggles to stay with his family on their small farm, despite the difficulties imposed by the flooding of the Amazon rivers.

1407502.title: Threnodia
1407502.overview: A runaway couple takes on a journey of love, subconsciousness, and remorse; while believing that a homeless gay man is God.

1410702.title: And Now It's Over
1410702.overview: Mauritius. A love story begins between Pierre, a local employee, and Louise, a French tourist suffering from anorexia. He shows her another side of his country: wild beaches, nightlife, bustling streets... Each, in their own way, dreams of escape and emancipation. But Louise's departure is approaching, and Pierre grows tense at the thought of staying on this island he is desperate to leave. He will risk everything in an attempt to escape a future that seems already written.

1411598.title: HALF
1411598.overview: Twin half-blooded vampires wage war with desert highway hijackers

1447630.title: The Burglars
1447630.overview: An elderly woman, Eunja, who lives in the countryside, teams up with Palbok, a burglar, to embark on a spree of robbing empty houses.

1452110.title: Clean Hands
1452110.overview: The true story of hero drug cop turned recovery advocate Kevin Simmers and his daughter Brooke. The film examines the American drug crisis and "the thin blue line" from the opposing eyes of cop and addict who were also father and daughter.

1467790.title: Attention: Children
1467790.overview: It's a kaleidoscope of children's lives, emotions and dreams during the Russian invasion of Ukraine. The children will try to survive and overcome the traumas caused by the war by talking through and immersing their memories.

1467982.title: Love Punch!
1467982.overview: A delinquent who swore off fighting and love is tested when the leader of a rival school moves into his family's candy shop.

1469518.title: Особый пациент
1469518.overview: Brilliant plastic surgeon Berladin takes on the most challenging case of his career—restoring the face of the disfigured sergeant major, Perkhun. While helping his patient find hope for the future, the doctor unexpectedly encounters his own family secret. These circumstances upend his life, forcing him to radically reassess his past and concepts of goodness and justice. The fates of the surgeon and his patient become inextricably intertwined, and the trials they face force each to choose between duty, love, and the right to start anew.

1471822.title: The Frog Princess 2
1471822.overview: Continuation of the fairy tale "The Frog Princess" with Valentina Lyapina and Nikita Kologriv.

1477454.title: Volcanic vs. Pedex

Seeing this as an invasion, Pedex confronts him, and the two engage in a violent battle between Fire and Darkness. The conflict extends beyond the Shadow Realm and extends to the small fictional town of Oldwood, where the fighting becomes even more intense and destructive.

1478606.title: Enigma
1478606.overview: Natalie and Miles fall into an unusual dream in a dark room.

1480654.title: The Wild Between Us
1480654.overview: Liam and Ava live far from civilization with their young son, Aru. When Liam returns from a hunting trip to discover signs of a bear, and the lifeless body of his wife, he is left alone with his child. Convinced that the wild is no place for a boy, Liam embarks on a perilous horseback journey to find someone he can trust with Aru’s future. As father and son venture deeper into the wilderness, their journey becomes a meditation on grief, survival and the meaning of paternal instinct.

1510542.title: A Day in the Life of Jo: Chapter Phaedra
1510542.overview: Jo, a 15-year-old tomboy, has a nightmare made of fog and aurora light: her dog is lost, her voice cannot be heard, and her surroundings seem completely unfamiliar. Has the tone of the day been set yet?

1512014.overview: Mira and Daisy thought one last score would be their way out. But when things go sideways and someone from their past comes looking for payback, they're left running with a bag full of cash, a broken promise, and nowhere to turn but each other. With love hanging by a thread and danger closing in, they have to decide if what they have is strong enough to survive, or if the escape they dreamed of was never real.

1523598.title: Naina
1523598.overview: 3 Majnus And 33 Lailas !!!!!!  Just Imagine The Chaos................

1530062.title: Order of the Dragon

As Rico's mission leads him to a small, danger-ridden town in Serbia, the lines between good and evil begin to blur. Is Ryker the monster he's made out to be, or is there a deeper conspiracy at play? What begins as a black-and-white hit spirals into a moral storm-and time is running out.

1530510.title: Mexico 86
1530510.overview: When a last-minute chance to host the 1986 World Cup appears, a cunning Mexican bureaucrat, armed with nothing but guts and audacity, cons his way through FIFA to beat the United States, but in a country of power games, every victory has a price.

1545870.overview: A women's support group takes in Olivia, who is vulnerable after the death of her twin sister Patricia. But in this sect, the peace she hoped for becomes her worst nightmare.

1546190.title: VENDETTA-THE BEAST WITHIN
1546190.overview: An assassin’s brutal past collides with fate, igniting relentless revenge.

1555726.title: The Prick
1555726.overview: After a devastating breakup, Hsing becomes emotionally numb, feeling unable to move on. But in the bitterly cold northern city, tangled desires bloom like a thorned flower—hurting him in return. While his ex finally offers him an olive branch by expressing remorse with kisses, Hsing just snaps. In that moment, apology, forgiveness, and revenge collide, leading to an irreversible act…

1558094.title: Let Love In
1558094.overview: After an affair comes to light, a couple's world unravels. Through confronting painful truths, they discover their crisis becomes a path to deeper connection and a new understanding of love.

1559118.title: In the Absence of Choice
1559118.overview: When a loyal enforcer of a vampire order begins to remember the night his childhood ended, the truth waiting in the dark threatens to consume what’s left of him.

1562638.title: Diamond

1564494.title: Harbinger
1564494.overview: Julia, sole survivor of late serial killer Decker, is lured back to the house she shared with him for a ghost hunting TV show. The crew discover the 'Harbinger' - a fairground fortune telling machine that reveals their fates one by one.

1568014.title: Disney-Ideologie
1568014.overview: Fairy tales are never just fairy tales. They shape how we think about power, inequality, and society. This film reveals what lies behind the colorful facade.

1575438.title: Finnegan's Foursome
1575438.overview: Two middle aged brothers and their respective sons travel to Ireland to play the Finnegan Family's annual golf outing, where they distribute the ashes of the family patriarch

1578318.title: Santa's Workshop
1578318.overview: Nine-year-old Mari is really looking forward to Christmas. Her journalist dad, Svein, on the other hand, loves his job so much, he barely notices the festive season. One night, Mari’s Christmas list vanishes – and in its place lies a mysterious mitten. The mitten sends Mari, Svein and her adventurous grandma on an exciting quest to find Santa Claus. Meanwhile, Stubby the Wishlist Elf is in a panic — he’s lost his mitten, which might just lead this curious family straight to the secret location of Santa’s workshop! He must stop them before it’s too late!

1582862.title: Mones
1582862.overview: Cici, a trans woman, confronts her gender dysphoria at her younger brother Teddy’s fraternity during a historic Pride party/drag show she put together with her best friends. As the drag performers, frat boys, and queers mingle, Cici has a romantic encounter with a familiar young man that leads to her overcoming her mental hurdles around being a woman. Ultimately, she learns the universal truth of womanhood… sometimes your titties just hurt! A high energy comedy that explores questions of identity.

1584782.title: All the Queens Houses
1584782.overview: A photographic exploration of Queens’ unconventional architecture reveals the borough’s beauty through the eyes of an architect while uncovering the deeper history behind its strange and spectacular designs.

1594190.title: The Flush
1594190.overview: In 2033, a health records chip enables coverage for medical needs. The FMC, valued at 3 trillion dollars, faces potential issues discovered by Ray Macintosh that could disrupt the healthcare model.

1596302.title: The Oldest Person in the World
1596302.overview: A decade-long global journey chronicles the ever-changing record holders of the title of oldest person alive. What begins as a portrait of longevity becomes a meditation on the passage of time, the randomness of fate, and the joy and profound human experience of being alive.

1599438.title: Treat Her Like a Lady
1599438.overview: When single mother Sandra, full of unwavering energy, is evicted from her apartment by the Dutch government due to fraud, she convinces her daughters Harrie and Stella that their emergency shelter is a holiday hotel. Taking care of her children while being the main breadwinner seems impossible, but Sandra won't go down without a fight: with heroism and creativity, she gives her daughters the best summer of their lives.

1600846.title: What We Saw
1600846.overview: A boy has died. On the final day of his brief life, the story traces not only his fading memories but also those of Mujin, the teacher who held him dear.

1602510.title: Trevor Lies
1602510.overview: The bizarre tale of a young boy and his puritan family who must grapple with the morality and consequences of deceit

1608590.title: Ce qui nous mène à toi
1608590.overview: Charlie and Hicham, both in their thirties, are deeply in love but unable to conceive; they are facing infertility. They embark on a journey of medically assisted reproduction. Over the course of three years—amidst hopes and disappointments—they put both their love and their bodies to the test, living through an odyssey that will profoundly transform them.

1609678.title: Aftertouch
1609678.overview: When a man introduces a thought experiment to hit his girlfriend with consent, their ordinary movie night takes a dangerous turn.

1627982.title: Мэхээлэчээн Булчут
1627982.overview: The wise hunter Mekhelecheen, living in harmony with nature, is concerned about his grandson Mishuk. The boy, spoiled by life, doesn't appreciate the legacy of his ancestors and doesn't understand the beauty of the harsh taiga. To pass on ancient knowledge to his grandson, his grandfather takes him into the dense forest. However, the journey turns into unexpected trials: Mishuk and his faithful dog, Sergekh, become lost in the forest. In despair, they encounter a magical deer—the guardian of the taiga—who grants the boy the amazing ability to understand the language of all living things. Together with his grandfather, he fights poachers to save the Spirit of the Taiga.

1630030.title: Demon Agent
1630030.overview: The fantastical and magnificent city of Chang'an, a city woven with gears and mechanisms, is home to both humans and demons living side by side beneath its upturned eaves. Di Shao, a genius young man aspiring to become "Chang'an's Number One Detective," possesses exceptional crime-solving skills and a sharp tongue; while Asa, a rookie wolf demon constable, is formidable in martial arts yet kind-hearted. A bizarre murder case forces these two adversaries to team up, embarking on a hilarious and bickering detective journey. As clues point to the heart of the city, can this unreliable duo protect the joyful daily life of this fantastical city? And what earth-shattering secret lies hidden behind the bustling and prosperous Chang'an?

1631822.title: Mary Oliver: Saved by the Beauty of the World
1631822.overview: From a lonely childhood to literary fame, her life was shaped by devotion to nature, paying attention, and the long journey toward learning to love and to be loved.  If poetry had a pop icon, Mary Oliver would be it.
1631822.trailerName: Mary Oliver: Saved by the Beauty of the World TRAILER

1644878.title: Lizzie

1649678.title: I Fought the Law

1651278.title: Blade Warrior of Blade Action
1651278.overview: Under the careful planning and command of Director Chen Hai’an, the special police unit to which Cheng Gang belongs to engages in a thrilling battle of wits and courage against a smuggling syndicate led by Huang Zan. The officers, especially Cheng Gang and Shen Xin, make tremendous sacrifices and selfless contributions to crack the cultural relics case and wipe out the criminals. In the end, they succeed in capturing the entire criminal group in one sweep.

1656014.title: Missing 411 National Parks: Washington State
1656014.overview: Washington State follows investigator David Paulides as he examines a series of unexplained disappearances in and around Mount Rainier and Olympic National Park, where hikers, climbers, and experienced outdoorsmen vanish without tracks, scent trails, or clear cause. Through interviews with families, witnesses, and search personnel the film contrasts known environmental dangers - severe weather, terrain, and hypothermia - with unsettling anomalies. Some of these include aircraft debris fields, unusual patterns in search failures, eyewitness encounters, and reported aerial phenomena dating back to the 1946 Curtis Commando crash and the dawn of the modern UFO era. As grief-stricken families search for closure and investigators compare evidence against established "profile points," the documentary challenges viewers to consider whether these cases can be explained by nature alone - or if something unknown operates within the wilderness.
1656014.trailerName: Missing 411 David Paulides Presents The Movie Trailer- Missing 411 National Parks- Washington State
